description: A `node_modules` inside an entrypoint, the mutation run's setup, a cache under the library's own `node_modules` and a file of the schematics hold a `<video>`, and so does a template of the primary entrypoint, listed after all four by name; 1.2.1 keeps resting on the scan. None of the first four reaches a page — the setup is imported by no entrypoint, a `node_modules` holds installed packages and the build's caches, and the schematics run in a terminal at `ng add` and `ng update` — so the reader leaves them out and the refusal names the template. A reader that took any of them names its line first. Laid on disk and read by the live reader (`tree`).
